title: Mande languages - Simple English Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
text: The Mande languages are a family of languages. They are spoken in many countries in West Africa by the Mandé peoples. Some of these languages are Maninka, Mandinka, Soninke, Bambara, Kpelle, Jula, Bozo, Mende, Susu, and Vai.

title: Kasaloo Kyanga
text: Kasaloo Kyanga (20 May 1957 – 9 September 2011) was a Congolese musician, guitarist, composer, and singer renowned for his contributions to East African rumba and soukous music, particularly through his work with Tanzanian-based orchestras in the 1970s and 1980s.
